asked.item: Canceled screen while Billing says ACTIVE
Do I have to pay again to get in

verdict.reason: S13-S15 cover this exact case: Billing shows ACTIVE but the canceled screen still appears.

steps.text: Don't pay again. If Billing shows your subscription is ACTIVE but you still see the canceled/reactivate screen, you don't need to pay.
The lock screen is stale on your browser.
Clear your browser cache, then log in again at my.blotato.com/login with your exact account email, spelled in all lowercase.
